Get The BookRead the first pages

An ordinary man. Seven powers. One guide.

What happens when a man rooted in quiet family life is suddenly handed seven miracle-like powers, and dropped into a fantasy world with an artificial intelligence as his only guide?

The Power Card blends portal fantasy, speculative science fiction and philosophical inquiry into a fast-paced serialized adventure. Instead of a chosen warrior, you follow an everyday man trying to understand the weight, rules and moral consequences of abilities that border on the miraculous, while a calculating AI helps him survive.

A grounded hero

A family man in extraordinary circumstances, bringing real-world perspective and heart to high-stakes fantasy.

Seven powers, one AI

Miracle-like abilities meet a cold, analytical artificial intelligence.

Philosophy in motion

Questions of chance, responsibility and human nature sit beneath mythic world-building.

A crisp read

Episode 1 is a focused novella of about 100 pages, with no filler.

Seven powers, three boxes

Daniel’s birthday gift is a white card listing seven powers. Only three can be checked at a time, and they can be swapped. Tap a card to reveal each power.

Chapter 1: The Quiet Angel

Daniel is stepping into the third decade of his life, where youth fades and destiny begins to whisper. He is waiting for a birthday gift that means something, not just a gift but a sign. Then, hidden in a cabinet, he finds a sleek white card and a simple marker.

“For now, consider your methods of using them in a way that you won’t violate ethics, moral conscience and the rights of others.”The instructions on the back of the card

About the author

Navid Arcan is a bilingual writer and narrative designer whose work blends mythic symbolism, philosophical tension and emotional nuance. Fluent in English and Persian, he explores the quiet spaces between power and restraint, often drawing from cross-cultural traditions and speculative futures.

With a background in publishing logistics and a passion for world-building, Navid approaches storytelling as both a craft and a meditation. He continues to write, translate and explore new forms of multimedia storytelling.

I didn’t write this to answer questions, but to honor them.Navid Arcan, Author’s Note

Coming soon: A More Realistic Realm

The next book dives deeper into the Celesterres realm, where time flows unlike Earth and years may pass in seconds. It explores Vivalibre, the essence of wisdom and reason, and shows how the future is a thread bound to the past.

Expect a world where cosmic laws bend, entities awaken and choices ripple across dimensions.
